is_other.description:
IsOther marks the single catch-all category sellers pick when nothing
else fits; selecting it reveals Product.CategoryOther for a free-text
description instead of relying on a fragile name match.

user_name.description: Populated at query time for admin endpoints only; not stored in DB.

url.description: URL is computed at request time from FileKey — not stored in DB.

features.description:
Features lists the feature keys this plan grants. A user's entitlements
are the union of Features across all their active subscriptions, so
à-la-carte plans ("A only", "A + B") and ladder tiers both work without
a schema change — which is why this is a list rather than a tier number.

Keys are free-form strings you define. The kit ships with the video
category keys from VideoCategory (CATEGORY_A/B/C) so that content gating
works out of the box: a video is unlocked when its Category appears in
the viewer's feature set. Add your own keys for anything else you sell.

category_id.description:
CategoryID is nullable so pre-existing products aren't broken by this
field's addition. CategoryOther holds the seller's free-text
description when CategoryID points at the "Other" category.

featured_seller.description: true when seller has active market plan with FeaturedSeller perk

seller_name.description: Populated at query time; not stored in DB.

is_other.description:
IsOther marks the single catch-all category sellers pick when nothing
else fits; selecting it reveals Product.CategoryOther for a free-text
description instead of relying on a fragile name match.

buyer_name.description: Populated at query time for admin endpoints only; not stored in DB.

fee_in_paise.description:
Fee snapshot taken at capture time so historic sales keep the fee
percent they were sold under. Zero on rows from before the wallet era.

x-enum-comments.SubscriptionPending: unused by Learning; reused by MarketPlanSubscription for unpaid orders

x-enum-descriptions: unused by Learning; reused by MarketPlanSubscription for unpaid orders

current_app_mode.description:
CurrentAppMode is the dual-mode app's active side for this user:
"" (legacy accounts predating this feature), "learning", or "market".
Set at registration now that mode is chosen before signup; changed later
only via the explicit mode-switch endpoint.

wallet_balance_in_paise.description:
Cached wallet balance; source of truth is the wallet_transactions ledger.
Mutated only via wallet.Apply, which row-locks this record first.

has_hls.description:
Safe "is transcoded" flag for clients — HLSKey itself is never
serialized (raw storage key), so the admin UI needs this to know
whether the HLS ladder exists. Set by the AfterFind hook.

transcode_started_at.description: Transcode timing, shown in the admin panel (how long each video took).

thread_user_id.description:
ThreadUserID identifies which end user's private conversation this row
belongs to. For a user-authored row it equals UserID. For an
admin-authored reply, UserID is the "admin" sentinel while
ThreadUserID is the target user — so a single
Where("thread_user_id = ?") query returns a user's own messages plus
admin's replies to them, never another user's rows.

balance_after_in_paise.description: Balance snapshot taken inside the row lock, for drift auditing.

upi_id.description: Payout destination snapshotted at request time.
